k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.title: Selected Pod and ConfigMap literals have no detected secrets
k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.description: Inspect literal env values, command and args in selected namespaced Pods and literal text values in selected ConfigMaps using both offline detectors.
k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected Pod specifications or ConfigMaps and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use an appropriate secret reference instead of embedding credential values.
k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.purpose: Coverage is limited to explicit selected literal content. References are never dereferenced, credential validity is not checked, and no Secret payloads, logs, exec, host paths or registry content are read.
k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.missing_observation: Selected supported literals could not be completely read, identity-bound and scanned with both offline detectors.
k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in selected Kubernetes literals.
k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in selected Kubernetes literals. The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.
